slots.notes: Floating looping muted/autoplay HLS (.m3u8) hero background video in an 80vh container positioned absolute bottom-[35vh], sitting behind the centered text at full 100% opacity with no dark overlay. Played through a memoized VideoPlayer using hls.js (with native application/vnd.apple.mpegurl fallback) and cleaned up on unmount. Native source is a Mux stream URL.
Row of three small 'Integrated with' logos, one per glass-effect badge pill above the headline. Supply as transparent currentColor/white marks so they read on black inside the frosted pills.

Static bottom row of grayscale, 40%-opacity partner/client logos (the spec uses placeholder SVGs). Rendered desaturated and dimmed, so supply as monochrome transparent SVGs; card count is the indicative number of logos in the row.

Navbar brand lockup, native value is the text wordmark 'Synapse' (font-medium, tracking-tight, white). Supply as a transparent/currentColor white lockup; swapping in an image/SVG mark replaces the text logo on the left of the blurred-glass navbar.

Single UI sans applied throughout the section (navbar wordmark + links, badges, ~80px headline, subtext, both CTA labels). Uses font-medium for the logo and a tight tracking on the large headline. The spec does not name a family, so the native value is the Tailwind default sans stack (system-ui / -apple-system / Segoe UI / Roboto).

mechanic: A static black hero floats an 80vh full-opacity hls.js background video (absolute bottom-[35vh]) behind a vertically-centered content column of glass badges, an ~80px tight-tracked headline, subtext and two layered CTAs under a fixed blurred-glass navbar, with motion/react staggered fade-in-up animating the badges, headline, subtitle and buttons on load.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion (motion/react), with the hls.js library driving the Mux HLS background video inside a memoized VideoPlayer component (native HLS fallback, cleanup on unmount).
reskinNotes: No font family is declared, so the layout (~80px tight-tracking headline) leans on the Tailwind default sans stack and will reflow if a brand face with different metrics is dropped in. The navbar 'Features' active state is a gradient-border treatment and 'Case Studies' is a strikethrough style baked into markup, and both CTAs are layered glass/gradient pills (white-to-gray gradient nav button; solid-black + white-border primary; transparent glass secondary) hardcoded around white-on-dark rather than tokenized, so retinting means editing the className constructions. The video sits with no overlay at 100% opacity and is parked with magic offsets (height 80vh, absolute bottom-[35vh]) tuned to the frame. All copy is hardcoded in JSX: logo 'Synapse'; nav 'Features / Insights / About / Case Studies / Contact'; nav CTA and primary CTA both 'Get Started for Free'; secondary CTA "Let's Get Connected"; the 'Integrated with' badge label; the headline 'Where Innovation Meets Execution'; and the two-line testing/deployment subtext. Marquee and integration logos are placeholder SVGs, so brand assets must be supplied to replace them.
